title: Bytes in order
description:
Write in `solution.c`, using shifts so the code gives the same bytes on any machine:

```c
void put_u16_le(unsigned char *out, uint16_t v);   /* low byte first */
uint16_t get_u16_le(const unsigned char *in);
void put_u32_be(unsigned char *out, uint32_t v);   /* high byte first */
uint32_t get_u32_be(const unsigned char *in);
uint32_t swap_bytes(uint32_t v);                   /* 0x11223344 becomes 0x44332211 */
```
